description: This file defines a WaterBase class in Unity representing water rendering properties, including shader update logic based on water quality and edge blending, as well as handling rendering setup.

classes.name: WaterBase
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that manages water shader quality and edge blending in Unity.

methods.name: UpdateShader
methods.description: Updates shader maximum LOD and edge blending keywords based on water quality and system support.

methods.name: WaterTileBeingRendered
methods.description: Ensures depth texture mode is set when the water tile is rendered with edge blending enabled.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Calls UpdateShader if shared material is assigned, to update shader parameters every frame.
